name: candor
description: Run AI-moderated user studies and human evaluations: create studies, recruit participants, and get prioritized findings.

interface.longDescription: Candor lets your agent run user studies and human evaluations with real participants. Describe what you want to learn; the agent drafts a study, shows the cost, waits for your approval, recruits participants or gives you shareable links, and returns prioritized findings or rankings. Requires the Candor CLI (installed on first use) and a Candor account. Needs a shell, so it works in Codex and ChatGPT desktop, not ChatGPT on the web.
defaultPrompt: Run a user study on this product's onboarding flow with 5 users
Compare these two landing page designs with real people
Show the findings from my latest Candor study
